judge.reason: q1: The diff adds `Stock.TimeLeft(id)` to inventory/inventory.go. It returns the time left until the reservation's `Expires`, and it returns ErrNoReservation for an unknown or expired reservation. The diff also adds `TestTimeLeft`, which checks three cases: the time left after the fake clock moves forward, an unknown ID, and the moment of expiry. The test moves the fake clock forward (`c.t = c.t.Add(...)`) instead of sleeping. This follows D-CLOCK.

finalMessage:
I added `Stock.TimeLeft(id)` to `inventory/inventory.go` and a test for it. Tests pass across all packages with `-race`, and `gofmt` and `go vet` are clean.

**Behavior:** `TimeLeft(id)` returns how long reservation `id` has until `Expires`. An unknown or expired reservation returns `ErrNoReservation`, the same rule `Confirm` uses. It takes the same lock and reads the injected clock, so it is safe for concurrent use.

I picked that ID and title myself, so please confirm them in review. `ostf check --base main` exits 0 and reports the new item as `[draft]`. Its only message is an info line about two existing items, `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, that nothing links to. That was already true before my change.

- `R-STOCK-EXPIRY`: my change keeps it true. It is read-only, and its code and test lists are unchanged.
